run_resynthesize_speech: run the GSLM U2S tool to resynthesize speech from an audio file using acoustic features, K-means quantization, Tacotron TTS, and Waveglow vocoder
run_main_resynthesis_loop: run the main resynthesis loop that extracts features, quantizes units, and synthesizes audio from input to output file paths
run_get_parser: run get_parser to build an argparse parser for the GSLM U2S tool with acoustic model, TTS, and Waveglow arguments
run_get_logger: run get_logger to create a configured logging instance with timestamp and level formatting for the GSLM tool
run_synthesize_audio_pipeline: run the full speech resynthesis pipeline extracting features with Hubert/W2V2/CPC, quantizing with K-means, and synthesizing with Tacotron and Waveglow
